metadata.author: Ella Shine
metadata.seriestitle: The Pet Sitters Ready for Anything Collection
metadata.description: Two best friends. One talking cat. What could possibly go wrong?  When Cassie and Lina volunteer to pet sit their neighbour’s grey and white cat, they think they are ready for anything. But pet sitting Gus is suddenly a lot more complicated than they thought. Have the best friends got what it takes to pet sit a grumpy talking cat? And if they do, will they be able to pet sit a sometimes-invisible guinea pig, a pony that can fly and a glitter-sneezing lizard too?!  Find out in this hilarious collection of stories about the Barefoot Springs Pet Sitters. The Ready for Anything Collection includes four original stories: Gus Makes a Fuss Purple Panic Tony Takes Off Glitter Jitters.
